moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-line-shadow, written here): A copy of the text offset +0.04 em x / y behind it, filled with 45° stripes (stripe 0.06 em, colour / transparent) via background-clip; stripes scroll background-position 0 0 → 100 % −100 % over 15 s linear, loop; main text static. Demo exaggerates: offset 0.09 em, pitch 0.14 em (lines 42 % of it), main text with a 2 px background-colour outline; 3 pitches per 3 s loop. Params: offset: độ lệch bóng (0.04 em) · stripe: bước sọc (0.06 em) · duration: một vòng trôi (15 s).
